prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic outdoor fashion portrait of an approved adult woman leaning against a textured stone wall.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with long loose dark-chestnut waves, looking downward with an introspective expression. She wears a cream floral off-shoulder tiered dress with puff sleeves and corset-style bodice, black choker, silver rings, and red bracelet, holding a dark green crocodile-texture cowboy boot.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level thigh-up portrait with body angled against irregular grey-beige stone masonry, soft depth behind, hands posed naturally at chest and side.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused daylight, even gentle shadows, realistic dress, skin, hair, boot, and masonry texture, casual artistic bohemian mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 85mm f/2.8 portrait, vertical framing, sharp subject and dress detail, natural skin texture and depth.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical thigh-up portrait of an approved adult woman with long loose dark-chestnut waves leaning against an irregular stone wall. She looks downward with an introspective expression and wears a cream floral off-shoulder tiered dress with puff sleeves and corset-style bodice, black choker, silver rings, and red bracelet. She holds a dark green crocodile-texture cowboy boot by her side. Use soft diffused daylight, gentle shadows, 85mm f/2.8 perspective, detailed fabric and masonry, and a bohemian soft-grunge mood.
